rules.statement: In an action to set aside a deed of transfer on the ground that it was executed in fraud of creditors, the plaintiff must allege and prove either absence of consideration or actual fraud on the part of the purchaser.
rules.supporting_quote: "In Perera v. Menik Etana 1 [15 O. W. R. 258.] , which is a somewhat similar case, Shaw, J., sitting alone, held that in an action to set aside a deed on the ground that it was executed in fraud of creditors, the plaintiff has to allege and prove either that no consideration on the transfer was paid or actual fraud on the part of the purchaser."
